A regal elven queen seated upon a throne of woven living branches, gowned in pale petals and silver, a crown of antlers and starlight upon her brow, eyes ancient and endlessly serene.
An ethereal fae lord robed in shimmering moonlight, tall and severe, his silver hair unbound, drifting as though caught in an unseen wind, eyes twin pools of cold luminous violet.

A court of slender high-elves gathered in a sunlit glade, adorned in flowing silks of gold and white, their pointed ears adorned with gemstone chains, graceful and otherworldly in their studied stillness.
A tiny winged sprite no larger than a sparrow alighting delicately upon a blooming flower, her gossamer wings catching prism light, trailing faint golden motes with every infinitesimal movement.
A swarm of glowing pixies drifting through twilight forest air like living embers, each no bigger than a thumb, their collective radiance painting the mossy bark in shifting hues of rose and amber.

A fae maiden with enormous gossamer dragonfly wings hovering above a still pond, her iridescent gown rippling without wind, luminous skin faintly traced with glowing vein-like patterns of silver and pale blue.

An ancient antlered forest-spirit standing motionless among elder oaks, his body half bark and half flesh, moss draped across his broad shoulders, amber eyes glowing beneath a crown of tangled living branches.

A dancing circle of fae folk leaping barefoot through moonlit grass, their laughter soundless, garments woven of flower petals and cobweb, casting long impossible shadows that dance counter to their own bright movements.

A slumbering fae prince lying upon a bed of deep green moss, robed in pale silver cloth, his long dark lashes resting softly, wild roses growing gently upward around him as though drawn by his dreaming.

An elven harpist seated beneath a weeping willow, fingers moving across strings of spun starlight, her long copper hair falling loose, pointed ears adorned with leaf-shaped emeralds, eyes closed in transcendent musical reverie.

A horned faun piping softly at the forest edge, goat legs tucked beneath him, reed pipe pressed to smiling lips, his curling horns wreathed in tiny wildflowers, amber eyes half-closed in drowsy musical pleasure.

A luminous water-nymph rising slowly from a glassy forest pool, her hair trailing as living water, skin gleaming with inner pearl-light, draped in nothing but liquid shimmer and woven strands of river weed.

A moth-winged fae messenger alighting from swift flight, wings broad and dusted with pale silver scales, wearing a courier's sash of deep indigo, her luminous eyes wide with urgency, breathless and beautifully unearthly.
A wild fae huntress crouched upon a high branch, bow of living yew in hand, leaf-patterned cloak blending with the canopy, her sharp ears tilted forward, eyes bright gold and fiercely predatory.

A sorrowful banshee queen drifting through silver mist, her gown tattered white flowing behind her like smoke, long pale fingers outstretched, hollow luminous eyes carrying millennia of grief and terrible knowing beauty.

A pair of twin fae nobles standing mirror-still in identical robes of deep violet, their pointed features perfectly symmetrical, hair white as snow, sharing between them a single crown of polished obsidian and moonstone.

A young elven page boy in emerald livery kneeling to present a crystalline goblet, his bright ears pricked with silver rings, eyes wide with reverent attention, cheeks flushed faintly gold beneath luminous pale skin.

A fae sea-witch perched upon coastal rocks, kelp and pearl woven through her dark tangled hair, scaled robe shimmering like the open sea, her long fingers drawing runes in the salt air with casual power.

A willowy elven scholar surrounded by floating luminous tomes, her ink-stained fingers moving through pages of hovering light, silver spectacles upon her fine nose, robes deep midnight blue scattered with embroidered constellations.

A fae fire-dancer spinning at the center of an ember ring, her copper skin glowing from within, gown of flame-colored silk trailing sparks, hair wild and blazing as though genuinely alight with living fire.

A grave and ancient elven warrior standing in battered silver armor engraved with centuries of battle-records, long white hair bound in warrior knots, eyes gold and lidded with the weight of ten thousand years.

A gossamer-winged fae child asleep curled within a half-open rose bloom, thumb tucked near parted lips, tiny wings folded like a sleeping butterfly, breathing faintly amid drifts of luminous pollen in the warm still air.

A tall unseelie lord looming from shadow, his handsome face carved and cold, robes of black silk stitched with silver thorns, crown of jagged dark crystal, pale hands folded, eyes lit with dangerous amused intelligence.
A fae bard standing on a moonlit stone, lute of pale ashwood cradled close, his voice shaping visible golden ripples in the air, eyes shut, long braided hair threaded with tiny chiming silver bells.

A regal elven high-priestess kneeling before a flame-filled altar, white robes embroidered in sacred silver script, antlered headdress rising tall, her lifted face serene and luminous, slow tears of molten gold tracing her perfect cheeks.
